commit.author: Samuel Bharti <samuelbharti.io@gmail.com>
commit.message:
docs: fix moved and plain-http links in the README

urlchecker flagged six moved links in the README. It suggested
https://ropensci.org/contact.html for the rOpenSci contact page, but
that returns 404, so the link now points at
https://ropensci.org/contact/. Five more plain-http links, in the badges
and two images, move to https as well, and urlchecker now reports every
URL as correct.

The sentence calling rentrez part of the fulltext suite is gone, since
ropensci/fulltext is archived.

README.md and README.Rmd get the same edits by hand. Knitting the Rmd
would rerun 28 live NCBI calls, including the popset walkthrough that
#214 reports as broken, and upload its figures to imgur again.
